oracle.command: kubectl --context kind-fathom-oracle apply --dry-run=server -f <objectFile> (real apply for passing-mutated); serverMessage is stdout+stderr verbatim
oracle.cliInvocation: env -i HOME=<scratch> PATH=/usr/bin:/bin /home/luk/go/bin/kyverno apply <policies> --resource <object> [side-file flags]; cli/out/<case>.txt is stdout+stderr verbatim

scenarios.name: violating-team
scenarios.notes: ClusterPolicy deny condition and message both read ConfigMap s3/allowed-teams (context entry configMap). Offline the CLI only honours the ConfigMap through --values-file rule values (policies[].rules[].values.allowedTeams.data.teams); --resource and --context-file leave the context nil (error result). Message text identical to the server.
scenarios.serverMessage:
Error from server: error when creating "objects/violating-team.yaml": admission webhook "validate.kyverno.svc-fail" denied the request: 

resource Deployment/s3/web-violating was blocked due to the following policies 

require-team-label:
  team-label-allowed: label team=pirates is not one of the allowed teams [platform,payments,search] (ConfigMap s3/allowed-teams)

scenarios.name: passing-mutated
scenarios.notes: Real apply; the cluster stored runAsNonRoot=true and label fathom.dev/mutated-by. kyverno apply -o <dir> writes <name>-mutated.yaml (4-space indent, trailing ---) with the same labels and securityContext (cli/out/web-passing-mutated.cli.yaml); no Kyverno patch annotation on the server object. golden/passing-mutated-dryrun.server.txt is the --dry-run=server verdict.

scenarios.name: excused
scenarios.notes: No team label at all; kyverno.io/v2 PolicyException legacy-app-team-label excuses it. Chart default is --enablePolicyException=false; the oracle runs with features.policyExceptions.enabled=true, namespace=s3. CLI: --exception <file> turns the rule into result skip (report message 'rule is skipped due to policy exceptionss3/legacy-app-team-label', sic). Without --exception the CLI gives error (nil context) not fail.

scenarios.name: protected-admin
scenarios.notes: Precondition on request.userInfo.groups (AnyNotIn system:serviceaccounts:argocd) then deny: {}. CLI --userinfo cli/userinfo-admin.yaml reproduces the server message verbatim including the JSON-rendered groups list. Without --userinfo the CLI still fails but renders 'requester UNKNOWN has groups []'.
scenarios.serverMessage:
Error from server: error when creating "objects/protected.yaml": admission webhook "validate.kyverno.svc-fail" denied the request: 

resource Deployment/s3/web-protected was blocked due to the following policies 

restrict-protected-deployer:
  argocd-only: protected Deployments may only be applied by the argocd service account (group system:serviceaccounts:argocd); requester kubernetes-admin has groups ["kubeadm:cluster-admins","system:authenticated"]

scenarios.name: protected-argocd
scenarios.notes: kubectl --as=system:serviceaccount:argocd:argocd-application-controller --as-group=system:serviceaccounts:argocd --as-group=system:serviceaccounts --as-group=system:authenticated; RoleBinding snapshot/rbac-argocd.yaml is needed so the impersonated subject passes RBAC. CLI with --userinfo userinfo.yaml: precondition false -> result skip (pass: 0, skip: 1), exit 0.

scenarios.name: vap-violating
scenarios.notes: apiserver enforces the VAP itself (no Kyverno involved). CLI: --parameter-resource alone yields pass 0/fail 0/skip 0 because the binding's namespaceSelector cannot be matched; adding --values-file namespaceSelector[].labels for s3 makes it fail with the server's messageExpression text. Supplying the Namespace via --resource instead makes the CLI evaluate the VAP against the Namespace object too (error: no such key: spec). Missing parameter -> error ('composited variable "maxReplicas" fails to evaluate: no such key: data'), not the binding's parameterNotFoundAction=Deny.
scenarios.serverMessage: The deployments "web-too-many" is invalid: : ValidatingAdmissionPolicy 's3-replica-limit' with binding 's3-replica-limit-binding' denied request: replicas 5 exceeds maxReplicas 3 from ConfigMap replica-limits

scenarios.name: vpol-excused
scenarios.notes: policies.kyverno.io/v1 ValidatingPolicy is served by v1.19.1 (kubectl api-resources: validatingpolicies vpol). Applied to the cluster separately and removed afterwards. Its webhook is vpol.validate.kyverno.svc-fail and the denial format is 'Policy <name> failed: <message>' (one line). The kyverno.io/v2 PolicyException does not cover it, so legacy-app is denied. Offline it needs --context-file (cli.kyverno.io/v1alpha1 Context, spec.resources[] holding the ConfigMap) for resource.get('v1','configmaps','s3','allowed-teams'); --resource and --values-file give error. vpol-violating-team.server.txt shows the ClusterPolicy webhook answering first for the team=pirates object, vpol-passing.server.txt the allow. vpol-violating-team.server.txt is NOT deterministic: both Kyverno validating webhooks (validate.kyverno.svc-fail for the ClusterPolicy, vpol.validate.kyverno.svc-fail for the ValidatingPolicy) deny the object, the apiserver calls them in parallel and kubectl prints whichever fails first; both observed texts are kept (golden/vpol-violating-team.server.txt and golden/vpol-violating-team.alt.server.txt). fathom must therefore report every denial, not the first one.
scenarios.serverMessage: Error from server: error when creating "objects/excused.yaml": admission webhook "vpol.validate.kyverno.svc-fail" denied the request: Policy vpol-require-team-label failed: label team=MISSING is not one of the allowed teams [platform,payments,search] (ConfigMap s3/allowed-teams)

fails: --resource <configmap> (CLI logs 'disabled loading of ConfigMap context entry'; context nil -> result error)

cliSideFiles.userinfo: userinfo.yaml: cli.kyverno.io/v1alpha1 UserInfo with roles[], clusterRoles[], userInfo{username, groups[]} (kyverno create user-info emits the same without apiVersion/kind)
cliSideFiles.vapParameter: --parameter-resource <configmap file> plus --values-file namespaceSelector[] for the binding's namespaceSelector
cliSideFiles.exception: --exception <kyverno.io/v2 PolicyException file>; matched rule -> result skip
cliSideFiles.mutateOutput:
-o writes -mutated.yaml per resource; plain output prints 'policy

applied to //:' + YAML when more than one policy runs

cliOutput.header: Applying N policy rule(s) to M resource(s)[ with K exception(s)]...
cliOutput.summaryLine: pass: N, fail: N, warn: N, error: N, skip: N  (trailing space)
cliOutput.errorLines: none in plain or --detailed-results output; only the summary count and the report's message reveal an error
cliOutput.deprecation: Warning: <file>: kyverno.io/v1 ClusterPolicy is deprecated and will be removed in a future release; migrate to ... (also for kyverno.io/v2 PolicyException)

exitCodes.1: any fail ('exit as there are policy violations') or any error ('exit as there are policy errors'); --warn-exit-code N for warnings

policyReport.metadata.name: merged
policyReport.results[]: message, policy, rule (absent for ValidatingPolicy), result pass|fail|skip|error, scored, source kyverno|ValidatingAdmissionPolicy|KyvernoValidatingPolicy, properties{process, binding, exceptions, cel.validationIndex}, resources[], timestamp{seconds,nanos}
policyReport.note: VAP results carry properties.process 'background scan' even offline; --output-format json emits the same object as JSON

twoPass: One kyverno apply invocation runs mutate before validate on the same object: probe cli/probe-require-nonroot.yaml fails alone (xi-twopass-validate-only, exit 1) and passes together with (b) (xi-twopass-mutate-then-validate, pass: 2). Full chain (xii-full-chain: a,b,c,d,f + all side files, 5 objects): pass 15, fail 5, skip 1; the five failures are exactly the five server denials.
coldStartCommand: date +%s%N around: kyverno apply policies/a-require-team-label.yaml --resource objects/passing-mutated.yaml --values-file cli/values.yaml
replayVerified: commands.sh replayed end-to-end after the first capture: every golden/*.server.txt byte-identical except the webhook race noted for vpol-violating-team; every cli/out/*.txt identical modulo report timestamps and result ordering in the multi-object report (xii-full-chain-report results are emitted in nondeterministic order).
